measurement_window.semantics: Frame counts/bytes use application-observed frame completion times; startup_bytes counts complete-frame bytes, not all raw bytes. Additional startup raw remains separately preserved. A passing activity gate does not prove uninterrupted communication or product acceptance.

limitations: Application Read is not proof of kernel-pending requests or physical host polling.
Continuous native Read and parser-pump fairness are evaluated independently.
Unparsed raw suffixes are preserved but never accepted as communication success.
Read timestamps cannot correlate MCU time without a bounded nonce exchange.

READ_BEGIN is an application call boundary, not proof of a kernel-pending request or host USB polling.
Native no-data retries are summarized by reader counters; not every timeout is a trace event.
READ_END and FRAME_COMPLETE are application observations, not physical USB arrival timestamps.
Startup-drain bytes may predate Open or the read loop.
QPC ticks alone cannot correlate a separate device clock.
If dropped_events is nonzero the trace must not prove missing event ordering.

parser_service_scope: LIVE parser pump including final interval; separate bounded terminal-tail drain excluded. Native Read service is checked for the entire Open-to-cleanup lifetime.
